subject: GPU hold request — CloudNova Sherpa POC & Dedicated sizing
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@cloudnova.ai>
To: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudNova Procurement <procurement@cloudnova.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sherpa POC sizing & short-term GPU hold request

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. The Sherpa team is excited to move to a short two-week POC and we have an internal exec review next Friday. To make the POC meaningful we need dedicated capacity for inference (low-latency chat + batch embedding jobs).

Quick asks from our side:
- Can Redwood provision a provisional hold on ~12 A100-equivalent GPU slots for the window 2027-03-08 to 2027-03-22 while we finalize legal/PO?
- We attached a short requirements doc with peak token rates and expected concurrent sessions.
- What telemetry/redlines would you need to lock pricing for a potential 6-month reserved capacity?

If possible please confirm the hold by EOD Friday so we can present to procurement. We understand this is provisional and can be time-limited.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director of AI Platforms | CloudNova
--
Sherpa POC requirements attached: Sherpa_POC_requirements.pdf
From: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@cloudnova.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sherpa POC sizing & short-term GPU hold request

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the clear requirements doc. We can do a provisional hold but I need ops to confirm capacity and finance to note any commercial constraints. Looping in Neha and Vivek.

Internal asks for us:
1) Neha — can you size from the attached PDF and give a recommendation (A100-equivalent count, expected vCPU/RAM per instance) and whether 12 GPUs is the right starting point?
2) Vivek — can we temporarily reserve that capacity for 2 weeks starting 2027-03-08 without impacting committed customers? If yes, any blackout windows?
3) Marissa — procurement will want a short memo on commercial guardrails for provisional holds (credit, cancellation window, rate that applies if converted to reserved).

Elena — I will aim to confirm back by Friday EOD.

Best,
Jonas
VP, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2027 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Sherpa POC sizing & short-term GPU hold request

Jonas —

I reviewed Sherpa_POC_requirements.pdf and ran a quick capacity-sim using last-quarter traffic profiles for similar chat+batch mixes. High-level recommendation:

- Provisional sizing: 10 x A100-40GB (or 12 x if they insist on headroom).
- Rationale: expected concurrent sessions ~140, peak tokens/sec aligns with 10 cards with 2x batching.
- Per-instance: 8 vCPU, 64GB RAM, NVMe cache recommended for KV persistence.
- Expected token throughput: ~1.2M tokens/hour sustained for peak windows.

I generated a provisional sizing workbook (provisional_sizing.xlsx). Notes: we can vertically scale if they want to convert to reserved, but short holds of >2 weeks complicate scheduling for Dedicated pool.

Tagging Priyom for fleet-level impact (hoarding risk) — Priyom, any objections to a 2-week hold for this footprint starting 2027-03-08?

-Neha
Senior Infra Planner | Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: provisional_sizing.xlsx
From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2027 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sherpa POC sizing & short-term GPU hold request

Quick ops check:

We have a small amount of short-term buffer in the west-us Dedicated pool for March 8–22 but it is tight due to two other provisional holds (non-committed). Granting a 10-GPU hold is feasible under these conditions:
- Hold policy: provisional holds consume soft capacity and are reclaimable with 72h notice if a higher-priority committed customer needs capacity.
- We can mark the hold with a tag "provisional:CN-SHERPA-2027" and enforce a hard start/end window.
- No impact to SLA-backed reservations if we tag properly and keep the 72h reclaim clause.

If Sales/Finance want stronger guarantees we need a short commitment (1–3 month reserved with a reduced rate) or an escrow deposit.

Priyom
Fleet Capacity Manager | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2027 09:54:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sherpa POC sizing & short-term GPU hold request

Inside finance/commercial —

If ops can do a provisional 10-GPU hold with the 72h reclaim clause, our recommendation for the customer note is:
- Hold term: 2 weeks (2027-03-08 to 2027-03-22) with automatic release unless customer signs PO.
- Conversion: up to 10% credit applied if they convert to 6+ month reserved within 14 days after the hold (to discourage gaming).
- Deposit: optional refundable deposit equal to one week of usage to secure stronger guarantee (recommended for deals over $50k ARR).

Jonas — please confirm if you want us to offer the deposit option to CloudNova.

-Marissa
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@cloudnova.ai>
To: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sherpa POC sizing & short-term GPU hold request

Thanks everyone — that all sounds workable.

We accept the provisional 10-GPU hold with the 72h reclaim clause. Procurement will issue a non-binding LOI and we are open to the refundable one-week deposit if Redwood wants it as a stronger guarantee; Elena will confirm with finance by EOD Thursday. We will push to sign a 6-month reserved agreement if the POC results are positive.

Next steps:
- Jon as AE: confirm the hold and the tag so ops can mark it in the console.
- Neha/Priyom: place the provisional tag and confirm blackout windows (if any) by EOD Friday.
- Marissa: prepare a short commercial note for procurement describing the deposit/credit mechanics we discussed.

Appreciate the fast coordination.

—Elena
Director of AI Platforms | CloudNova
